Motion & Voting
Amendment to the Main Motion: I move an amendment to the Superintendent’s boundary adjustment recommendations to keep the community called “Stonebrook at Westfield” at its current schools of Chantilly High School and Franklin Middle School.

Motion by Ilryong Moon, second by Seema Dixit.
Final Resolution: Motion Fails
Yes: Ilryong Moon, Seema Dixit, Mateo Dunne, Ricardy J Anderson
No: Sandy B Anderson, Karl V Frisch, Melanie K Meren, Kyle McDaniel - Vice Chair, Robyn Lady - Chair, Tom Dannan, Marcia St John-Cunning
Main Motion: That the School Board approve boundary adjustments as described in the Superintendent’s recommendation attached.

Motion by Seema Dixit, second by Sandy B Anderson.
Final Resolution: Motion Carries
Yes: Sandy B Anderson, Karl V Frisch, Melanie K Meren, Ilryong Moon, Kyle McDaniel - Vice Chair, Robyn Lady - Chair, Seema Dixit, Mateo Dunne, Tom Dannan, Ricardy J Anderson, Marcia St John-Cunning
